pages.description: Mo Chuid Amhráin Ghaeilge is a collection of favourite Irish songs for children, helping little ones learn and sing as Gaeilge.
pages.ld_description:
Mo Chuid Amhráin Ghaeilge 1


Suitable for young children and families, making it easy to share the joy of Irish music from an early age.


A Cogs bestseller: beautiful interactive sound book featuring 6 beloved traditional Irish songs, including Báidín Fheilimí, Peigín Leitir Móir, and Óró, Sé do Bheatha Abhaile. 🎶


Press a button to hear each song sung by four talented young Irish singers, encouraging kids to sing along.


Illustrated by Tatyana Feeney with bright pastel artwork throughout, making every page visually captivating.


Encourages cultural connection and Irish language learning through music and play.


Battery included and replaceable, so the songs can be enjoyed for years to come.


Featured on the Late Late Toy Show, praised for its charm and educational value.


This delightful sound book is a perfect way for families to bond, share culture, and celebrate Ireland’s musical heritage—one enchanting song at a time. 🌟
